exposure: massive blood transfusion (≥10 U red blood cell infusion during cesarean section)
cohort: 587 patients who underwent blood transfusion during cesarean section
finding: Repeated cesarean section and placental previa combined with uterine scar are positively correlated with increased blood transfusion.
mod_finding: This study found an increase in blood transfusion during cesarean section, particularly in women with a history of cesarean section and placenta previa.
